purpose: Generic principles for writing requirement documents, used when no project-specific rules exist: defines the responsibility, scope, lifetime and revision of a requirements document.
summary: Requirements document responsibility: describe what to build from the user perspective
Excluded content: implementation methods belong to design documents
Exception: already-decided matters with no choice are written concretely
Lifetime is permanent but not immutable
Revision via additive development; the additive-side requirements are current during the period
Old requirements are not edited during implementation and are revised at merge
Project-specific rules take priority over these generic principles
title: 要件定義書 作成原則
